series.name: WindFree R-32 split inverter C-codes (AR9500T family)
series.notes: C-series codes for R-32 WindFree/split (AR9500T PK). SplitAtlas aggregator index cross-checked against Samsung E-code manuals — medium/high (aggregator + manual cross-check). C121 kept separate from E121.

meaning.en: The indoor room-temperature sensor reading is open/short or implausible, so the unit stops or limits operation.
meaning.ur: Indoor room temperature sensor ki reading khuli/short ya ghalat hai, is liye unit ruk jata hai ya mehdood chalta hai.

causes.en: TH sensor open/short or connector loose on indoor PCB
causes.ur: TH sensor khula/short ya indoor PCB par connector dhila

causes.en: Sensor probe damaged or stuck behind the coil
causes.ur: Sensor probe kharab ya coil ke peeche phans gaya

solutions.en: Power off/on once; if the code returns, technician measures sensor resistance
solutions.ur: Ek baar power off/on karein; code wapas aaye to technician sensor ki resistance napta hai

solutions.en: Reseat or replace the TH sensor harness
solutions.ur: TH sensor ka harness dobara lagayein ya badlein

notes.en: C-prefix display on R-32 WindFree models maps to service-manual E-family.
notes.ur: R-32 WindFree models par C-prefix display service-manual ki E-family se milta hai.

title.en: Indoor room temperature (TH) sensor error (second channel)
title.ur: Indoor room temperature (TH) sensor kharabi (doosra channel)

meaning.en: A second indoor temperature sensing channel reports an open/short or unusable reading.
meaning.ur: Doosra indoor temperature sensing channel khula/short ya ghair qabil reading batata hai.

causes.en: Second TH probe or harness fault
causes.ur: Doosra TH probe ya harness kharab

causes.en: Indoor PCB input channel fault
causes.ur: Indoor PCB input channel kharab ho gaya

solutions.en: Technician swaps probes to isolate the faulty channel
solutions.ur: Technician probe aapas mein badal kar pata lagata hai ke kaun sa channel kharab hua

solutions.en: Replace the faulty sensor or repair the harness
solutions.ur: Kharab sensor badlein ya harness ki marammat karein

notes.en: SplitAtlas text mirrors C101; treat as second-channel variant.
notes.ur: SplitAtlas ka text C101 jaisa hi hai; ise second-channel variant samajhein.

title.en: Indoor MID / indoor-inlet EVA-TH sensor error
title.ur: Indoor MID / indoor-inlet EVA-TH sensor kharab

meaning.en: The evaporator (indoor inlet) temperature sensor reading is open/short or unusable.
meaning.ur: Evaporator (indoor inlet) temperature sensor ki reading khuli/short ya ghair qabil hai.

causes.en: EVA-TH sensor open/short or poorly clipped to the coil
causes.ur: EVA-TH sensor khula/short ya coil par mazbooti se nahi laga

causes.en: Wiring chafed between indoor coil and PCB
causes.ur: Indoor coil aur PCB ke darmiyan wiring ghis gayi

solutions.en: Check sensor seating on the evaporator pipe and connector
solutions.ur: Evaporator pipe aur connector par sensor ki fitting check karein

solutions.en: Replace sensor if resistance is out of spec
solutions.ur: Resistance spec se bahar ho to sensor badlein

meaning.en: The indoor dust/filter-soiling sensor cannot be trusted, so auto modes that depend on it are blocked.
meaning.ur: Indoor dust/filter sensor par bharosa nahi kiya ja sakta, is liye us par chalne wale auto modes band ho jate hain.

causes.en: Dust sensor window coated with heavy dust
causes.ur: Dust sensor ki window par ghane ghabbar ki parat lagi ho

causes.en: Sensor harness unplugged or sensor failed
causes.ur: Sensor harness nikal gaya ya sensor kharab

solutions.en: Gently clean the dust sensor opening and filter area
solutions.ur: Dust sensor ka opening aur filter area halki safai se saaf karein

solutions.en: Technician checks/replaces the dust sensor if the code stays
solutions.ur: Code wapas aaye to technician dust sensor check ya badle

notes.en: Do NOT merge with service-manual E121; on R-32 WindFree tables C121 = dust sensor.
notes.ur: Ise service-manual E121 ke sath merge NA karein; R-32 WindFree tables par C121 = dust sensor hai.

meaning.en: The indoor motion/presence sensor used for WindFree air-sweep logic reports a fault.
meaning.ur: WindFree air-sweep logic ke liye jo indoor motion/presence sensor istemal hota hai, woh kharabi batata hai.

causes.en: Motion sensor blocked, dirty or failed
causes.ur: Motion sensor ka raasta band, ganda ya kharab ho gaya

causes.en: Harness/connection fault to the indoor board
causes.ur: Indoor board tak harness/connection kharabi

solutions.en: Clear obstructions in front of the sensor lens and clean it
solutions.ur: Sensor ke aage se rukaot hata dein aur saaf karein

solutions.en: Technician tests/replaces the motion sensor module
solutions.ur: Technician motion sensor module ko test ya badal kare

notes.en: WindFree-specific feature sensor; present on AR9500T-class models.
notes.ur: WindFree khaas feature sensor hai; AR9500T-class models par maujood hota hai.

meaning.en: A second motion/presence sensing channel reports a fault.
meaning.ur: Doosra motion/presence sensing channel kharabi ki khabar deta hai

causes.en: Second motion sensor module fault
causes.ur: Doosra motion sensor module kharab

causes.en: Harness or connector fault
causes.ur: Harness ya connector kharab

solutions.en: Technician isolates which motion channel failed
solutions.ur: Technician pata lagata hai ke kaun sa motion channel kharab hua

solutions.en: Replace the faulty motion sensor
solutions.ur: Kharab motion sensor badlein

meaning.en: The indoor blower is not running as commanded or feedback is missing.
meaning.ur: Indoor blower command ke mutabiq nahi chal raha ya feedback nahi aa raha.

causes.en: Indoor fan jammed, blade damaged or foreign object
causes.ur: Indoor fan phans gaya, blade kharab ya koi ajnabi cheez

causes.en: Fan motor, tacho wire or indoor PCB fault
causes.ur: Fan motor, tacho wire ya indoor PCB kharabi

solutions.en: Power off, clear the blower wheel, spin it by hand and restore power
solutions.ur: Power band karein, fan wheel saaf karein, haath se ghumayein aur power wapas laayein

solutions.en: If it still fails, technician tests fan motor/PCB
solutions.ur: Phir bhi kharabi ho to technician fan motor/PCB test kare

title.ur: Mixed operation error (ek saath heating + cooling ki maang)

meaning.en: Zones or mode logic ask for heating and cooling at the same time, which is not allowed.
meaning.ur: Zones ya mode logic ek hi waqt mein heating aur cooling maang lete hain, jo jaiz nahi.

causes.en: Conflicting zone demands on multi/linked systems
causes.ur: Multi/linked systems par zones ki aapas mein takraof (conflict)

causes.en: Mode/EEPROM setting corrupted
causes.ur: Mode/EEPROM setting kharab

solutions.en: Power cycle the system and reset mode/zone settings
solutions.ur: System ko power cycle karein aur mode/zone settings reset karein

solutions.en: Technician reviews zone configuration and EEPROM data
solutions.ur: Technician zone configuration aur EEPROM data ka jaiza leta hai

notes.en: More relevant to FJM/multi-zone; rare on single PK splits.
notes.ur: Yeh FJM/multi-zone ke liye zyada relevant hai; PK ke single splits par bahut kam milta hai.

meaning.en: An option/special-setting value stored on the unit is invalid.
meaning.ur: Unit par mojood option/special setting ki value invalid hai.

causes.en: Option dip/remote setting outside allowed range
causes.ur: Option dip/remote setting ijazat ki range se bahar

causes.en: EEPROM option data corrupted
causes.ur: EEPROM ka option data kharab ho gaya

solutions.en: Re-enter option settings per the user manual table
solutions.ur: User manual ki table ke mutabiq option settings dobara daalein

solutions.en: Technician reloads defaults or replaces EEPROM data
solutions.ur: Technician defaults dobara load kare ya EEPROM data badal de

meaning.en: The unit's filter-clogging feedback signal (K1) stays in the clogged state even after cleaning.
meaning.ur: Filter clogging feedback signal (K1) cleaning ke baad bhi clogged state mein rehta hai.

causes.en: Filter feedback switch/sensor stuck or wiring open
causes.ur: Filter feedback switch/sensor phans gaya ya wiring khuli

causes.en: Filter not fully seated after cleaning
causes.ur: Cleaning ke baad filter poori tarah baitha nahi

solutions.en: Refit the filter fully and clean the feedback contact
solutions.ur: Filter poori tarah lagayein aur feedback contact saaf karein

solutions.en: Technician checks feedback switch/wiring
solutions.ur: Technician feedback switch/wiring check kare

notes.en: Official PK page shows this as 'E1 54' loop; same fault.
notes.ur: Official PK page ise 'E1 54' loop ke tor par dikhata hai; yahi fault hai.

meaning.en: The condensate drain pump is not running or its feedback is missing when required.
meaning.ur: Condensate drain pump zaroorat par nahi chalta ya uska feedback nahi aata.

causes.en: Drain pump jammed, blocked line or failed pump
causes.ur: Drain pump phans gaya, line band ya pump kharab

causes.en: Pump wiring/relay fault on indoor board
causes.ur: Indoor board par pump wiring/relay kharabi

solutions.en: Check and clear the drain path; power cycle once
solutions.ur: Drain path check karke saaf kare; ek baar power cycle kare

solutions.en: Technician tests the drain pump and relay
solutions.ur: Technician drain pump aur relay test kare

notes.en: Risk of water spill; attend promptly.
notes.ur: Paani girne ka khatra hai; foran dekh lein.

meaning.en: The outdoor fan is not running to command or tacho feedback is missing.
meaning.ur: Outdoor fan command ke mutabiq nahi chal raha ya tacho feedback nahi aa raha.

causes.en: Outdoor fan jammed, blade broken or obstruction
causes.ur: Outdoor fan phans gaya, blade tooti ya rukaot

causes.en: Fan motor, connector or outdoor PCB fault
causes.ur: Fan motor, connector ya outdoor PCB kharabi

solutions.en: Isolate power, free the fan blade and check for debris
solutions.ur: Power band karein, fan blade ko ghumne dein aur moqa check karein

solutions.en: Technician tests outdoor fan motor and board
solutions.ur: Technician outdoor fan motor aur board test kare

notes.en: High-heat risk if outdoor fan cannot run; stop and service.
notes.ur: Outdoor fan na chale to zyada garmi ka khatra hai; unit band karke service karwayein.

meaning.en: Compressor discharge temperature stayed above the protection limit.
meaning.ur: Compressor ki discharge temperature protection limit se upar reh gayi.

causes.en: Low refrigerant charge, blocked coil or weak outdoor airflow
causes.ur: Refrigerant ki charge kam, coil band ya outdoor airflow kamzor

causes.en: Discharge sensor drift or condenser fouling
causes.ur: Discharge sensor drift ya condenser par moqa (fouling)

solutions.en: Clean condenser/evaporator and restore clear airflow
solutions.ur: Condenser/evaporator saaf karein aur clear airflow bahal karein

solutions.en: Technician leak-checks charge and verifies DIS-TH sensor
solutions.ur: Technician gas charge leak check karta hai aur DIS-TH sensor verify kare

title.en: Communication timeout: inverter micom ↔ main micom
title.ur: Communication timeout: inverter micom aur main micom

meaning.en: The outdoor inverter microcontroller and main microcontroller stopped exchanging data.
meaning.ur: Outdoor inverter microcontroller aur main microcontroller ka data lena dena ruk gaya.

causes.en: Internal outdoor board interconnect fault
causes.ur: Outdoor board ke andar ke interconnect ki kharabi

causes.en: Corrupt firmware/state after power surge
causes.ur: Power surge ke baad firmware/state corrupt

solutions.en: Power off 20–30 min, then restore and observe
solutions.ur: Power 20–30 minute band karein, uske baad wapas la kar dekhein

solutions.en: Technician services inverter/main board link
solutions.ur: Technician inverter/main board ki link theek karta hai

meaning.en: The compressor current-sense circuit reports an invalid reading.
meaning.ur: Compressor current-sense circuit galat reading batata hai

causes.en: Current sensor/CT failed on outdoor PCB
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB par current sensor/CT kharab

causes.en: Wiring/solder joint fault
causes.ur: Wiring ya solder joint kharab

solutions.en: Power cycle once; if persistent, leave off
solutions.ur: Ek baar power cycle karein; uske baad bhi rahe to band rakh dein

solutions.en: Technician replaces/repairs the current sensor circuit
solutions.ur: Technician current sensor circuit badalta ya theek karta hai

meaning.en: The discharge-temperature sensor itself is open/short or out of range.
meaning.ur: Discharge temperature ka sensor khula/short ya range se bahar hai.

causes.en: DIS-TH sensor open/short
causes.ur: DIS-TH sensor khula/short

causes.en: Harness damaged at compressor terminals
causes.ur: Compressor terminals par harness kharab

solutions.en: Technician measures sensor resistance vs temperature
solutions.ur: Technician sensor ki resistance temperature ke muqable mein napta hai

solutions.en: Replace sensor or repair harness
solutions.ur: Sensor badlein ya harness ki marammat karein

title.ur: EEV ya valve band hone ki kharabi (khud diagnosis)

meaning.en: The electronic expansion valve or a shut-off valve did not reach the commanded closed state.
meaning.ur: Electronic expansion valve ya band karne wala valve command ke mutabiq band nahi hua

causes.en: EEV coil/driver fault or valve stuck
causes.ur: EEV coil/driver kharab ya valve phans hua

causes.en: Wiring fault to EEV
causes.ur: EEV tak wiring kharab

solutions.en: Leave system off; technician cycles and tests EEV
solutions.ur: System ko band rakhein; technician EEV chalakar test kare

solutions.en: Replace EEV coil/driver or valve as diagnosed
solutions.ur: Diagnosis ke mutabiq EEV coil/driver ya valve badal dein

notes.en: Service manual index ambiguous; detail section names EEV/valve close.
notes.ur: Service manual ka index ghalat-maaloom hai; detail section mein EEV/valve close naam hai.

meaning.en: Outdoor conditions are outside the allowed cooling operating range, so cooling is blocked.
meaning.ur: Outdoor ki halat cooling ke ijazat wale range se bahar hain, is liye cooling band hai.

causes.en: Ambient too low/high for the permitted cooling range
causes.ur: Ambient temperature cooling ke ijazat wale range se zyada kam ya zyada hai

causes.en: Ambient sensor reading wrong, triggering a false block
causes.ur: Ambient sensor ki reading ghalat hai jo ghalat block trigger karti hai

solutions.en: Wait until outdoor conditions return inside the manual range
solutions.ur: Outdoor ki halat manual ke range mein wapas aane tak intezaar karein

solutions.en: Technician verifies ambient sensor if it appears in mild weather
solutions.ur: Mild weather mein aye to technician ambient sensor verify kare

meaning.en: The DC-bus voltage sense circuit reports an invalid value.
meaning.ur: DC-bus voltage sense circuit galat value batata hai

causes.en: Voltage divider/sensor fault on outdoor PCB
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB par voltage divider/sensor kharabi

causes.en: Mains disturbance or rectifier issue
causes.ur: Mains mein disturbance ya rectifier ka masla

solutions.en: Check mains supply stability and restore power
solutions.ur: Mains supply ki stability check karke power wapas laayein

solutions.en: Technician repairs the voltage sensing circuit
solutions.ur: Technician voltage sensing circuit theek karta hai

title.en: EEPROM data error (main micom ↔ inverter micom)
title.ur: EEPROM data ka error (main micom ↔ inverter micom)

meaning.en: EEPROM contents disagree between the main and inverter microcontrollers.
meaning.ur: Main aur inverter microcontrollers ke EEPROM data mein aapas mein farq hai

causes.en: EEPROM corruption after power loss mid-write
causes.ur: Write ke doran power cutne se EEPROM kharab ho gaya

causes.en: Board replacement without data transfer
causes.ur: Data transfer ke baghair board badalna

solutions.en: Power cycle; technician reloads EEPROM parameters
solutions.ur: Power cycle karein; technician EEPROM parameters dobara load kare

solutions.en: Replace the board if data cannot be rewritten
solutions.ur: Data wapas nahi likha ja sakta to board badlein

meaning.en: The EEPROM returns no usable data at boot.
meaning.ur: Boot ke waqt EEPROM se koi qabil-e-istemaal data nahi milta.

causes.en: EEPROM chip failed or unsoldered
causes.ur: EEPROM chip kharab ya solder nahi hua

causes.en: Corrupted firmware image
causes.ur: Firmware ki image kharab

solutions.en: Technician reprograms EEPROM or reflashes the board
solutions.ur: Technician EEPROM wapas program kare ya board reflash kare

solutions.en: Replace the board if reprogramming fails
solutions.ur: Reprogramming nakaam ho to board badlein

title.ur: IPM par zyada current ka error

meaning.en: The intelligent power module saw current beyond its limit and tripped.
meaning.ur: Intelligent power module ne limit se zyada current dekha aur trip ho gaya.

causes.en: Compressor stalled or winding short
causes.ur: Compressor phans gaya ya winding short

causes.en: IPM/driver or DC bus fault
causes.ur: IPM/driver ya DC bus kharab

solutions.en: Leave the unit off; do not force repeated starts
solutions.ur: Unit ko band rakhein; baar baar start zabardasti na karein

solutions.en: Technician tests compressor, IPM and DC bus
solutions.ur: Technician compressor, IPM aur DC bus test kare

notes.en: Repeated resets can damage the IPM; stop and call service.
notes.ur: Bar bar reset karne se IPM ko nuqsan ho sakta hai; band karke service bulayein.

meaning.en: The compressor failed to start or lost sync during startup.
meaning.ur: Compressor start nahi hua ya start ke doran sync chala gaya.

causes.en: Weak capacitor/driver, low charge or mechanical lock
causes.ur: Kamzor capacitor/driver, kam charge ya mechanical lock

causes.en: Rotor/position sensor fault
causes.ur: Rotor/position sensor kharabi

solutions.en: Power off; do not repeatedly retry starts
solutions.ur: Power band karein; baar baar start ki koshish na karein

solutions.en: Technician checks charge, driver and compressor
solutions.ur: Technician charge, driver aur compressor check kare

title.ur: Heatsink ki zyada temperature ka error

meaning.en: The inverter heatsink temperature exceeded the protection limit.
meaning.ur: Inverter heatsink ki temperature protection limit se upar chali gayi

causes.en: Outdoor fan weak or heatsink fins clogged
causes.ur: Outdoor fan kamzor ya heatsink fins band

causes.en: Heatsink sensor fault or high ambient
causes.ur: Heatsink sensor kharabi ya ambient zyada

solutions.en: Clean outdoor unit fins and ensure clear airflow
solutions.ur: Outdoor unit ki fins saaf karein aur airflow khul rakhein

solutions.en: Technician checks fan and heatsink sensor
solutions.ur: Technician fan aur heatsink sensor check kare

meaning.en: The power-factor-correction stage is overloaded and shut down.
meaning.ur: Power-factor-correction stage overloaded ho kar band ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Mains voltage out of range or repeated brown-outs
causes.ur: Mains voltage range se bahar ya baar baar brown-out

causes.en: PFC reactor/capacitor or sensor fault
causes.ur: PFC reactor/capacitor ya sensor kharabi

solutions.en: Verify stable supply; leave off if breaker trips
solutions.ur: Supply ke mustaqbil hona check karein; breaker trip ho to unit band chhoonein

solutions.en: Technician inspects PFC circuit
solutions.ur: Technician PFC circuit ka jaiza leta hai

meaning.en: Outdoor conditions are outside the allowed heating operating range.
meaning.ur: Outdoor ki halat heating ke ijazat wale range se bahar hain.

causes.en: Ambient outside permitted heating range
causes.ur: Ambient heating range se bahar

causes.en: Outdoor sensor reading incorrect
causes.ur: Outdoor sensor ki reading ghalat

solutions.en: Wait for conditions to return inside the manual range
solutions.ur: Halat manual ke range mein wapas aane tak intezaar karein

solutions.en: Technician verifies outdoor temperature sensor
solutions.ur: Technician outdoor temperature sensor ko verify kare

meaning.en: The inverter heatsink temperature sensor is open/short or out of range.
meaning.ur: Inverter heatsink ka temperature sensor khula/short ya range se bahar hai.

causes.en: Heatsink sensor open/short
causes.ur: Heatsink sensor khula/short

causes.en: Connector loose on outdoor PCB
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB par connector dhila

solutions.en: Switch off and isolate power to the outdoor unit before removing the heatsink sensor.
solutions.ur: Heatsink sensor nikalne se pehle outdoor unit ka power band kar dein.

solutions.en: Disconnect the sensor and measure its resistance with a meter, comparing it with a known-good sensor; an open circuit, a short or a value outside the normal curve means the sensor has failed, so replace it.
solutions.ur: Sensor nikal kar meter se uski resistance nap lein, use kisi theek sensor se compare karein; circuit khula, short ho ya value curve se bahar ho to sensor kharab ho gaya hai, ise badal dein.

solutions.en: If the sensor reads normal, check the connector on the outdoor PCB for looseness, repair any damaged harness wire and retest after powering on.
solutions.ur: Agar sensor theek nap jaye to outdoor PCB ka connector dhila hai ya nahi check karein, kharab taar theek karein aur power on karke dobara test karein.

notes.en: Also cited in PK multi-brand technician videos as a Samsung code.
notes.ur: PK ke multi-brand technician videos mein bhi ise Samsung code ke tor par bataya gaya hai.

meaning.en: The mains input voltage sensing circuit reports an invalid value.
meaning.ur: Mains input voltage sensing circuit galat value batata hai

causes.en: Voltage sensor/divider fault
causes.ur: Voltage sensor/divider ki kharabi

causes.en: Mains over/under-voltage event
causes.ur: Mains par over/under-voltage ka waqia

solutions.en: Check supply with a meter; restore stable power
solutions.ur: Meter se supply check karein; stable power wapas laayein

solutions.en: Technician repairs the input sensing circuit
solutions.ur: Technician input sensing circuit theek karta hai

meaning.en: DC-bus voltage is outside the under-voltage/over-voltage protection window.
meaning.ur: DC-bus voltage under-voltage/over-voltage ki protection window ke bahar hai

causes.en: Mains brown-out or surge
causes.ur: Mains brown-out ya surge

causes.en: Rectifier/capacitor or sensor fault
causes.ur: Rectifier/capacitor ya sensor kharabi

solutions.en: Stabilise mains supply and power cycle once
solutions.ur: Mains supply stable karein aur ek baar power cycle karein

solutions.en: Technician checks rectifier, bus caps and sensor
solutions.ur: Technician rectifier, bus caps aur sensor check kare

title.ur: Compressor ki wire ghaib hone ki kharabi

meaning.en: A compressor phase wire is open or not detected.
meaning.ur: Compressor ki aik phase wire khuli hai ya detect nahi hui

causes.en: Compressor terminal wire loose/broken
causes.ur: Compressor terminal ki wire khuli ya tooti hui

causes.en: Connector not seated after service
causes.ur: Service ke baad connector fit nahi hua

solutions.en: Power off; technician reseats and continuity-tests compressor wires
solutions.ur: Power band karein; technician compressor wires dobara lagakar continuity test kare

solutions.en: Repair/replace damaged lead
solutions.ur: Kharab lead ki marammat kare ya badal dein

meaning.en: The outdoor ambient temperature sensor is open/short or out of range.
meaning.ur: Outdoor ambient temperature sensor khula/short ya range se bahar hai.

causes.en: OUT-TH sensor open/short or exposed wiring
causes.ur: OUT-TH sensor khula/short ya khuli hui wiring

causes.en: Connector corrosion
causes.ur: Connector par zang lagana

solutions.en: Technician measures sensor and checks harness
solutions.ur: Technician sensor napa aur harness check kare

solutions.en: Replace sensor if out of spec
solutions.ur: Sensor spec se bahar ho to badlein

meaning.en: The condenser/coil temperature sensor reading is open/short or unusable.
meaning.ur: Condenser/coil temperature sensor ki reading khuli/short ya ghair qabil hai.

causes.en: CON-TH sensor open/short
causes.ur: CON-TH sensor khula/short

causes.en: Harness damage at outdoor coil
causes.ur: Outdoor coil par harness kharab

solutions.en: Power off and isolate the outdoor supply before touching the condenser sensor wiring.
solutions.ur: Condenser sensor ki wiring chhoone se pehle outdoor supply ka power band kar dein.

solutions.en: Locate the CON-TH sensor on the condenser coil, unplug it and measure resistance at room temperature; an open, shorted or out-of-curve reading means the sensor has failed, so fit a replacement of the correct type.
solutions.ur: Condenser coil par CON-TH sensor dhoondein, nikal kar room temperature par resistance nap lein; circuit khula, short ho ya curve se bahar reading aaye to sensor kharab hai, sahi type ka naya lagayein.

solutions.en: If the sensor is within spec, inspect the harness at the outdoor coil for chafing or breaks, repair or replace it, refit the connector and clear the code with one power cycle.
solutions.ur: Agar sensor spec ke andar ho to outdoor coil par harness ka ghisna ya tootna dekhein, use theek ya badal kar connector dobara lagayein aur ek baar power band karke wapas chalayein taake code hat jaye.

title.ur: Gas ki kami ka error (refrigerant kam)

meaning.en: The system detected a refrigerant shortage (under-charge) and stops to protect the compressor.
meaning.ur: System ne refrigerant ki kami dekh li (under-charge) aur compressor ki hifazat ke liye ruk jata hai

causes.en: Leak in the circuit leaving low charge
causes.ur: Circuit mein leak ki wajah se gas/charge kam ho gaya

causes.en: Poor past charging or restricted filter drier
causes.ur: Pehle charging kamzor ya filter drier band

solutions.en: Stop and schedule leak testing by a licensed technician
solutions.ur: Unit band karein aur licensed technician se leak test karwayein

solutions.en: Repair leak, evacuate and recharge to specification
solutions.ur: Leak ki marammat karein, hawa nikaalein aur specification ke mutabiq gas bhar dein

notes.en: R-32 systems: service only; no homeowner gassing.
notes.ur: R-32 systems: sirf service; ghar walon ki apni gas filling nahi.
